title: Fix GatherItemDecompose over-mining — mine single source block with fallback
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-PLAN-001

`GatherItemDecompose` in `HtnTaskLibrary.cs` (~line 820) iterates ALL source blocks in `spec.SourceBlocks` and emits a `MineBlock` action for each, all with the full requested count. For `OakLogSpec` (7 source blocks: oak, birch, spruce, dark_oak, jungle, acacia, cherry) with count=10, the plan contains 7 separate `MineBlock` actions each targeting count=10 — up to 70 blocks mined for 10 requested.

**Recommendation:** Mine only the first source block that has a `BlockNotFound` fact absent (i.e., known to be present in the current biome). Fall through to additional variants only after the first returns `BlockNotFound`.
